metadata.title: Greenwood Homes | Award-Winning Custom Home Builder
metadata.description: Award-winning custom home builder serving Nevada, California, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah since 1998 with over 50 completed homes.

sections.purpose: Provide persistent navigation to the company's main site areas.
Establish who Greenwood Homes is and the scale of their work as a custom home builder.
proof: Over 50 custom homes completed since 1998
Serving Nevada, California, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah
Seven Tahoe Quarterly Mountain Home Awards including 2025 and 2023

sections.purpose: Build trust by showing licensed coverage and recognized professional credentials across all served states.
proof: Licensed General Contractor in California, Nevada, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah
LEED Accredited Professionals on the project team
Building custom homes since 1998

sections.purpose: Show the range and locations of completed homes and signature projects.
proof: Portfolio of more than 40 featured completed homes across Lake Tahoe, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah
Projects at Kukuiula, Martis Camp, Dollar Point, Carson Valley, and Gozzer Ranch
Built the Tahoe Provisions Market at the Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe
Completed a roughly 5,000-square-foot Incline Village dream home under time and under budget
Completed a partially built Glenbrook project after the original builder went bankrupt

sections.purpose: Detail the construction services and pre-construction expertise offered.
proof: New construction, remodels, renovations, additions, tenant improvements, and energy-efficient upgrades
Pre-construction services including estimating, feasibility review, value engineering, MEP review, constructability review, risk assessment, and scheduling

sections.purpose: Demonstrate reliability through experience, repeat clients, and on-time, on-budget delivery.
proof: Building custom homes since 1998
Repeat clients and multi-project homeowners, some building multiple homes with the company
Projects delivered on time and on budget
Superintendents with 25 to over 50 years of construction experience

sections.purpose: Show recognition from published design awards.
proof: Seven Tahoe Quarterly Mountain Home Awards including 2025 and 2023
Additional Tahoe Quarterly Craftsmanship, Legacy Home, Merit, and Interior Design awards between 2014 and 2021

sections.purpose: Share client satisfaction and trust through direct quotes.
proof: Client praised Kevin Hanna as honest, a good communicator, and a perfectionist, calling the experience the best
Lakeshore Boulevard client confirmed home completed on time and on budget
Property owner noted Greenwood exceeded expectations on the Hyatt Regency Tahoe Provisions Market project
Clients describe the experience as truly great from start to finish and exceeding all expectations
